items.colloc: find in the enclosure 在附件中找到 | send an enclosure 發送附件
items.distinct: attachment 電子郵件附件 | appendix 書籍附錄
ex: Please find the signed contract in the enclosure.
請查閱附件中已簽署的合約。
The enclosure contains all necessary financial reports.
附件包含所有必要的財務報告。
She failed to include the required enclosure.
她未附上要求的附件。

items.colloc: foreign correspondent 外派記者 | maintain a correspondent 保持通信
items.distinct: correspondence 通信；一致性 | correspondent 通信的人
ex: He is a senior correspondent for the journal.
他是該期刊的資深通訊記者。
Our business correspondent covers the Asian market.
我們的商務記者負責報導亞洲市場。
They have been correspondents for many years.
他們已經通信多年了。

items.pos: n. 詳細說明；詳盡闡述
items.colloc: require further elaboration 需要進一步說明 | provide elaboration 提供闡述
items.distinct: explanation 解釋 | clarification 釐清
ex: The proposal requires some elaboration before approval.
該提案在批准前需要詳細說明。
His plan needs more elaboration to be clear.
他的計畫需要更多細節才清楚。
She gave an elaboration on the new policy.
她對新政策做了詳盡說明。

items.colloc: extend the courtesy 給予禮貌 | as a professional courtesy 基於專業禮貌
items.distinct: politeness 禮貌 | manners 舉止
ex: He extended the courtesy of an early notice.
他出於禮貌提前通知了我們。
Please show professional courtesy to all clients.
請對所有客戶展現專業禮貌。
The company offered this as a courtesy.
公司基於好意提供了這項服務。

items.colloc: keep it concise 保持簡潔 | a concise report 簡潔的報告
items.distinct: brief 短暫的；簡短的 | short 短的
ex: Please write a concise summary of the meeting.
請為這次會議寫一份簡潔的總結。
He delivered a concise update to the board.
他向董事會做了簡明的進度匯報。
The manual is very concise and helpful.
這份操作手冊非常簡潔實用。

items.colloc: reiterate the importance 重申重要性 | reiterate the position 重申立場
items.distinct: repeat 重複 | emphasize 強調
ex: The manager reiterated the need for punctuality.
經理重申了守時的重要性。
Let me reiterate our commitment to quality.
讓我重申我們對品質的承諾。
She reiterated her point during the discussion.
她在討論中重申了自己的觀點。

items.colloc: avoid any omission 避免任何遺漏 | due to an omission 由於遺漏
items.distinct: deletion 刪除 | absence 缺席
ex: The report contains a serious omission of data.
報告中遺漏了重要的數據。
Please check the document for any omission.
請檢查文件是否有任何遺漏。
It was an honest omission on my part.
這是我方無心的疏忽。

items.colloc: formalize the agreement 使協議正式化 | formalize a procedure 使流程正式化
items.distinct: confirm 確認 | authorize 授權
ex: We need to formalize our partnership soon.
我們需要儘快將合作關係正式化。
The committee will formalize the new rules.
委員會將會將新規則正式化。
They are working to formalize the process.
他們正致力於將流程正式化。

items.zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的
items.colloc: a persuasive argument 有說服力的論點 | highly persuasive 極具說服力
items.distinct: convincing 令人信服的 | influential 有影響力的
ex: He gave a persuasive presentation to investors.
他對投資人做了場有說服力的簡報。
The proposal is quite persuasive and logical.
這份提案相當有說服力且合乎邏輯。
She is a very persuasive negotiator indeed.
她確實是一位很有說服力的談判者。

items.colloc: solicit feedback 徵求回饋 | solicit advice 請求建議
ex: We decided to solicit feedback from employees.
我們決定徵求員工的回饋。
The company will solicit bids for the project.
公司將為該專案公開徵求投標。
They are soliciting donations for the charity.
他們正在為慈善機構募款。

items.colloc: inadvertent mistake 無意的錯誤 | inadvertent error 不注意的失誤
items.distinct: careless 粗心的 | intentional 故意的
ex: It was an inadvertent error in the budget.
預算中出現了無意的誤差。
Please apologize for the inadvertent delay today.
請為今天的無意延誤致歉。
The change was an inadvertent oversight only.
這個變動僅僅是一個無意的疏忽。

items.colloc: amend the contract 修訂合約 | amend the proposal 修改提案
items.distinct: modify 修改 | revise 修訂
ex: We need to amend the terms of service.
我們需要修訂服務條款。
The board decided to amend the bylaws.
董事會決定修訂組織章程。
She amended the letter to be clearer.
她修改了信件使其更清楚。

items.colloc: follow the protocol 遵循規範 | office protocol 辦公室禮儀
items.distinct: procedure 程序 | rule 規則
ex: You must follow the established security protocol.
你必須遵守既定的安全規範。
It is standard protocol to greet guests.
接待客人是標準的禮儀。
They signed a new diplomatic protocol today.
他們今天簽署了一份新的外交議定書。

items.colloc: seek clarification 尋求釐清 | provide clarification 提供說明
items.distinct: explanation 解釋 | elaboration 詳細說明
ex: Please contact me for further clarification today.
請聯絡我以取得進一步的釐清。
The email requires clarification on some points.
這封郵件在某些點上需要說明。
He provided clarification regarding the new policy.
他針對新政策提供了說明。

items.colloc: first draft 第一版草稿 | draft a letter 起草信件
items.distinct: outline 大綱 | sketch 素描
ex: I have finished the first draft already.
我已經完成初稿了。
Please draft a memo to all staff.
請起草一份發給所有員工的備忘錄。
The draft is subject to further review.
這份草稿仍需進一步審核。

items.colloc: strictly confidential 極度機密 | confidential information 機密資訊
items.distinct: private 私人的 | secret 秘密的
ex: This document is strictly confidential and private.
這份文件是極度機密且私人的。
Please keep this information confidential always.
請務必將此資訊保密。
They handle confidential files in the office.
他們在辦公室處理機密檔案。

items.colloc: intended recipient 目標收件人 | notify the recipient 通知收件人
items.distinct: sender 寄件人 | addressee 地址收件人
ex: Ensure the recipient address is correct now.
確保收件人地址現在是正確的。
The intended recipient never received the email.
預定的收件人從未收到郵件。
She is the recipient of the award.
她是該獎項的得主。

items.colloc: transcribe the minutes 記錄會議記錄 | transcribe the audio 轉錄音檔
items.distinct: translate 翻譯 | interpret 口譯
ex: The assistant will transcribe the meeting minutes.
助理將會把會議記錄騰寫出來。
Please transcribe the interview from the tape.
請將採訪內容從錄音帶中謄錄出來。
She needs to transcribe all the notes.
她需要將所有的筆記謄寫一遍。

items.colloc: finalize the budget 敲定預算 | finalize the plan 完成計畫
items.distinct: finish 結束 | complete 完成
ex: We need to finalize the schedule today.
我們今天需要把時間表敲定。
They will finalize the deal next week.
他們下週將會完成這筆交易。
The manager is finalizing the project report.
經理正在完成專案報告。
